streets.name: Main Commercial Avenue
streets.player_purpose: Primary first-session spine from harbor arrival through tavern, counting house, shops, and island exit.
streets.ground_type: wide cobble and wagon-worn harbor street
streets.landmark_sightline: Tavern west, Counting House center, guidepost east.
streets.camera_readability_note: At gameplay zoom this road must read as a place the player is standing in, not a thin map line.

streets.name: Harborfront Road
streets.player_purpose: Southern working road where cargo moves between wharf apron and commercial lots.
streets.ground_type: wet cobble, planks at wharf edge, mud feathering
streets.landmark_sightline: Water edge and warehouse doors always visible south of the road.
streets.camera_readability_note: Camera must preserve the water/wharf edge so the player understands arrival.

streets.name: Rear Service Street
streets.player_purpose: Back-of-house service route that makes lots and daily work believable.
streets.landmark_sightline: Rear gates and residence row establish that buildings have backs.
streets.camera_readability_note: Should read narrower than the main avenue but still allow two NPC clearances.

streets.name: Central Upland Counting House Connector
streets.player_purpose: Clear uphill route from harbor work into official records and civic pressure.
streets.landmark_sightline: Counting House sits at the north end; wharf cargo remains visible behind player.
streets.camera_readability_note: Route view must show the target building and enough street width for human scale.

streets.name: West Tavern Connector
streets.player_purpose: Secondary arrival-to-tavern route with strong landmark pull.
streets.landmark_sightline: Tavern sign and porch are the vertical target.
streets.camera_readability_note: Must feel like walking uphill into a social node, not cutting between icons.

streets.name: East Market Connector
streets.player_purpose: Market and exit connector that makes the east side a district, not a dead end.
streets.landmark_sightline: Market shed and exit guidepost line the player's next move.
streets.camera_readability_note: Should show continuation out of town without swallowing the market lots.

streets.name: Dock Paths and Cargo Landings
streets.player_purpose: Work paths across cargo landings and finger piers.
streets.ground_type: planks, wet mud, rope-bounded walking lanes
streets.landmark_sightline: Warehouse and boathouse doors anchor pause points.
streets.camera_readability_note: Camera must prove wharf apron width, not hide it behind cargo scatter.

streets.name: Hidden Rumor Service Cut-through
streets.player_purpose: Optional narrow route for hidden clue discovery and overheard rumor geography.
streets.ground_type: packed dirt, broken cobble, low fence edges
streets.landmark_sightline: Tavern rear gate and cargo stack mark both ends.
streets.camera_readability_note: Narrow, but still at least 3 character widths and not clutter-blocked.

streets.name: Village-to-Island Road
streets.player_purpose: Obvious exit route that pulls the player from town into island exploration.
streets.ground_type: cobble fading to dirt and grass shoulder
streets.landmark_sightline: Guidepost and road bend visible from market edge.
streets.camera_readability_note: Exit should read as continuation, not a blank map border.

streets.name: Optional Secret / Side Path
streets.player_purpose: Subtle clue route for players following rumor-network hints.
streets.ground_type: grass/dirt footpath with sparse edge markers
streets.landmark_sightline: Back-lane fence break points toward the island road.
streets.camera_readability_note: Must remain readable as optional, not confuse the critical route.
